## Setup


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(bmm)
library(brms)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidybayes)
library(here)

source(here("_common.R"))  # shared workshop colors + ggplot theme
```
:::

## Load the fitted model

All workshop models ship pre-fitted in `models/` — nothing to compile,
nothing to wait for:

<!-- TODO (Gidon): once sdt_binary.rds is committed, remove `eval: false`

     worked analysis. -->


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
fit_sdt <- readRDS(here("models", "sdt_binary.rds"))
```
:::
